title: M1: Preview, revise and atomically accept curated examples
description: M1: Optional priming through validated structured files and language-neutral external HTTP transformation. Configurable item schema and classifier revisions drive templates, labels and rationales. Async start/status/clarification/feedback/cancel yields complete candidates; explicit preview acceptance commits items and human classifications with raw provenance and exact model representation. First integration reuses Papyrus scholarly and web curation planners and shared embedded UI. Local tests/preview only; draft PRs, no merge/deploy/IAM. Earlier callable draft at 2a45f44 is superseded.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope clarified: first integration reuses Papyrus reference processing/curation planners and embeds the shared Cyclotron UI in Papyrus. Separate domain service from host transport. Standalone hosting uses configured transformers. Reference.create currently persists before enrichment; preview must reuse planning stages without applying writes. No schema plugin revival, new public feed, keys, cloud calls or deployments.
